Container.Name: shin-wallslice
Container.Overview: Form-fit any wallpaper to all your devices. Drop in an image, pick your phones, tablets, laptops and monitors, and get a correctly sized wallpaper for each with the subject kept centered. Subject detection runs locally; no cloud services required.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Where 'Save to output folder' writes wallpapers (one sub-folder per device). Existing files with the same name are overwritten.

Config.Name: Working data
Config.Description: Temporary uploads and previews. Safe to delete; expires automatically.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns written files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns written files.

Config.Name: Naming provider
Config.Description: Optional AI file naming: anthropic, openai or openai-compatible. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: Naming API key
Config.Description: API key for the naming provider.

Config.Name: Naming model
Config.Description: Model id (optional for anthropic/openai; required for openai-compatible).
